copy.subject: The Block You Didn't Choose
copy.lede: It rarely announces itself before it acts.
copy.body: Some patterns aren't yours to begin with. You inherit more than colouring or a turn of phrase. Sometimes it's a way of holding back — a hesitation that shows up before certain decisions, one you didn't build and can't quite trace to anything you did. It might look like putting off a call you've already decided to make, or circling back to the same door you never open. Your reading looks at where that block actually comes from, and why it keeps showing up in the same shape. It isn't there to be endured. It's there to be understood — once you see the reason behind it, it tends to lose its grip.
